subject: Staged commitment staircase + billing escrow plan for Marketplace private offer
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mediluxe.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@mediluxe.com
Date: 2027-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MAP + procurement path for AWS Private Offer (target: Oct close)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profiles and the Dedicated capacity option. We're moving this through procurement and legal and I wanted to start a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones and invoicing. High-level ask:

- We prefer to purchase via AWS Marketplace Private Offer if possible (we have Marketplace purchasing mandates).
- Target: sign PO and activate private offer by end of October.
- Procurement needs: a clear checklist (security evidence, SOC2, billing contacts, tax forms), draft agreement for the private offer, and an estimate of invoice cadence (monthly vs. quarterly).

Can you send a proposed MAP with checkpoints and who owns each item? Also flag any "escape hatch" if marketplace activation lags and we need a temporary invoicing route.

Thanks — I can loop in finance if useful.

Best,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of IT Procurement, MediLuxe
procure@mediluxe.com
+1 415 555 0162
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mediluxe.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP + procurement path for AWS Private Offer (target: Oct close)

Hi Daniel — thanks for outlining the timing. Attaching a working MAP and a procurement checklist to get started (see attachment list). High-level approach below; I'll own the MAP coordination and weekly status.

Staged commitment staircase (proposed checkpoints):
1) Technical evaluation (two-week window) — Redwood: provide evaluation keys, onboarding guide, test prompts; MediLuxe: run internal perf/security tests. (Target: complete by 2027-09-17)
2) Security evidence review — Redwood: provide SOC2 report, encryption/KMS notes, and IP handling doc. (Target: 2027-09-24)
3) Commercial & procurement alignment — agree billing path (Marketplace Private Offer vs Redwood invoice), provide invoice contact, tax forms. (Target: 2027-10-01)
4) Private Offer execution & DocuSign — Redwood legal prepares private offer paperwork (if using AWS PO, we coordinate with AWS rep). (Target: 2027-10-08)
5) Activation & billing cutover — enable private offer and confirm billing cadence; if marketplace activation is delayed, use temporary Redwood invoice (billing escrow / credit note) until marketplace billing is live. (Target: 2027-10-15)

Notes:
- Marketplace private offer is preferred; we can open the AWS PO form and draft the private offer SID immediately.
- The "billing escrow" idea is a short-term mechanism where Redwood issues a one-time invoice and then re-invoices through AWS once the private offer is active; we'll track adjustments in a single ledger line to avoid duplicate billing.

Attachments: 20270903_MAP-draft.xlsx, procurement-checklist.pdf

I'll put Ben on the thread for pricing and billing options. Would you like weekly 30-minute syncs?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mediluxe.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-06T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP + procurement path for AWS Private Offer (target: Oct close)

Daniel — brief note on commercial mechanics and pricing cadence.

Pricing & billing options (summary):
- Option A: AWS Marketplace Private Offer (preferred by MediLuxe) — procurement issues PO to AWS; AWS invoices MediLuxe; AWS pays Redwood on agreed settlement terms. Advantage: aligns with your purchasing mandates; expected activation lead time 3–10 business days after PO acceptance.
- Option B: Redwood invoice (temporary) — Redwood issues a direct invoice (Net 30) while marketplace onboarding completes. We apply a credit note when marketplace billing becomes active.
- Option C: Dedicated reserved capacity contract — customer signs Redwood MSA and a reserved capacity addendum; Redwood invoices directly on monthly schedule. (This is a fallback if marketplace is constrained.)

I've attached pricing-summary.xlsx with the committed and burst bands and the expected unit costs for the Dedicated pools versus Marketplace SKU. Deal ID: DLX-RW-2027-092 (please reference this on the PO).

Next steps:
- If you confirm Option A, we'll draft the private offer and coordinate with our AWS partner rep (I can trigger once we have the procurement contact + purchase order template).
- If you need the interim Redwood invoice path, say so and we'll prepare an invoice and credit note template.

I'll prepare a short pricing annex to slot into the private offer.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-08T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: procurement asks we should pre-seed into the MAP

Folks — quick internal checklist I want included explicitly in the MAP before we send the final version to MediLuxe: 
- Confirm MediLuxe billing contact + remit address and whether they need tax-exempt paperwork.
- Ask for legal point of contact for the marketplace private offer redline window and expected SLA on turnaround.
- Prepare DocuSign envelope: private offer + pricing annex + credit-note template (in case we do the temporary Redwood invoice).
- Add an "activation escrow" row: if AWS activation extends beyond 10 business days post-PO, Redwood issues a temporary invoice and marks it as provisional; once marketplace billing is live, we issue a credit and re-bill through AWS (no double charge).

I'll take responsibility for the DocuSign prep and the credit-note wording. Olga — can you ask MediLuxe for the remit details and PO routing? I'll draft the DocuSign stack.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mediluxe.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@mediluxe.com
Date: 2027-09-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP + procurement path for AWS Private Offer (target: Oct close)

Hi Olga / Ben / Karthik — this looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. A few quick confirmations: 

- We will proceed with Option A (AWS Marketplace Private Offer) as the primary route. Expect a standard internal PO routed to AWS Legal/Procurement; please include the Deal ID on the PO (DLX-RW-2027-092).
- Our Finance lead (CC'd) will need a copy of the pricing annex and the planned invoice cadence; monthly is fine.
- I'll attach our PO routing guide for Redwood to confirm the required fields. (See attachment: MediLuxe_PO_instructions.pdf)

Please go ahead and create the DocuSign envelope for the private offer + pricing annex. If marketplace activation takes longer than expected, we accept the temporary Redwood invoice mechanism as long as credits are issued promptly.

We'll schedule a 30-minute sync early next week to lock the technical evaluation dates.

Regards,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of IT Procurement, MediLuxe
